papers.title: Genomic characterization and transcriptional studies of the starch-utilizing strain Bifidobacterium adolescentis 22L
papers.scope: Strain-specific starch/glycan metabolism; not proof of lactate enantiomer exchange.

papers.title: Glycan cross-feeding activities between bifidobacteria under in vitro conditions
papers.scope: 22L lactate production measured in glycan culture; HPLC-RI, Shodex Sugar SH1011 and lactic-acid standard. Does not report D/L-resolved production or a net L-lactate consumption assay.

inference: Total lactate production cannot validate the two stereospecific flux claims. Absence of a found experiment does not establish biological absence.
